verdict.rationale: Marqeta's MCP server explicitly restricts AI agents to 'a designated set of Marqeta's Core API endpoints' and offers 'customizable velocity limits, spending caps, and merchant restrictions' for agent-driven card usage, which reflects a least-privilege stance for agent access [marqeta-docs-11, marqeta-docs-13, marqeta-docs-38]. However, there is no documented general mechanism for developers to mint scoped/limited API keys or credentials (e.g., granular OAuth-like scopes, per-agent key issuance/revocation) for the broader Core API — the scoping shown is limited to the MCP tool surface and card spend controls. Missing for 10: explicit API credential/key scoping model, documentation of least-privilege API key issuance for arbitrary agents, and independent corroboration of this restriction in practice.
